policy: Synthetic local functional/resource rejection limits, not a crossover, throughput SLA, HA proof or blame benchmark. Fixed before qualification; failed limits must not be retuned against results.

rationale.latency: Generous finite local deadlines reject hangs and severe source interference, not small performance differences.
rationale.storage: Allow full-page WAL, TOAST, indexes, read holds and four small transactions; cap amplification without requiring S3 to win.
rationale.replication: Require an actual healthy streaming standby, bounded observed lag and replay of the final primary WAL fence.
rationale.headroom: Sample primary memory and CPU under its declared cap. Memory headroom is gated; CPU headroom is diagnostic because a half-core primary may briefly saturate. Source tails/errors are separately gated.
rationale.copies: Count fixture file materialization and verified digest input; count actual forwarded TCP bytes. Driver, allocator, kernel and TLS copies are not fully observable and no zero-copy claim follows.
